items.claim: Kuniev excels at utilizing a body lock to push opponents against the cage.
items.quote: His body lock, he'll get to it and he'll stick to it whether he pulls you down or keeps you on the feet, he just sticks to that body lock and then often ends up pushing them against the cage.

items.claim: Kuniev has strong top control, particularly from side control or the mounted crucifix.
items.quote: Once he gets either the side control or the mounted crucifix, that's where he has a lot of success.

items.claim: Temirov is on a five-fight win streak.
items.quote: Temirov is 5-0 in the last five at 19 and two looks good on that record.

items.claim: Erceg has lost three of his last five fights to high-level competition.
items.quote: Erceg two and three in the last five, but when you look at the level of competition, the three losses are to pretty high level competition

items.claim: Temirov is a powerful striker who relies heavily on winging wild overhands and spin kicks.
items.quote: For Temirov, he's a good striker with a lot of power and he's going to come forward and he's going to wing wild overhands as well as some spin kicks.

items.claim: Erceg has durability issues and has been hurt and knocked out in multiple fights.
items.quote: durability though, that's the problem. I get nervous watching him fight if I'm if I've picked him to win. And that's because we've seen him really hurt in a lot of fights and knock out in fights as well.

items.claim: Erceg has good straight punches, high volume, and active kicking from both legs.
items.quote: He's a good striker, right? He's got good straight punches, good volume, good combinations, super active lead leg. He lands front kicks and leg kicks off of either leg

items.claim: Guskov is taking the fight on about a week and a half to two weeks notice.
items.quote: Guskov's taking this fight on I you know, probably week and a half, two weeks notice.

items.claim: Guskov has gone 4-0-1 in his last five fights.
items.quote: Guskov, he's 4-0-1 in his last five fights.
